verdict.rationale: Finix documents holding seller funds in a Finix balance, configurable payout schedules, and dispute monitoring/response workflows (finix-docs-12,13,15,17,25,26), which together give developers control over when funds are released and how disputes are handled. However, there is no explicit documentation of an escrow-like mechanic tied to delivery confirmation or dispute-window timers, nor documented limits (max hold time, fund release triggers) as the story specifies. Missing for 10: explicit escrow/hold-until-delivery feature description, documented hold-time limits, and dispute-window-triggered release logic.
